This supplementary analysis examines the incidence of severe bleeding among prevalent patients with atrial fibrillation, categorized by their type of anticoagulation treatment [^src1]. The data reveals significant variations in bleeding risks depending on the specific medication regimen prescribed, highlighting the clinical importance of monitoring combination therapies.

Patients receiving a combination of both [[doac|DOAC]] and [[marevan|Marevan]] exhibit the highest risk, acting as the clear leaders in severe bleeding incidence with a rate of 6.45% (69 out of 1,069 patients) [^src1]. In stark contrast, the trailer for this measure is the group receiving neither DOAC nor Marevan, which records the lowest severe bleeding rate at just 1.31% (357 out of 27,331 patients) [^src1]. 

Among those on defined single therapies, Marevan monotherapy shows a severe bleeding rate of 2.38% (154 cases), while the broader category of any anticoagulation treatment (AK-behandling) sits at 2.30% (2,349 cases) [^src1]. The overall cohort (Alle) experiences a 2.14% severe bleeding rate [^src1]. Notably, the data for DOAC monotherapy is entirely absent in this specific table section, acting as an outlier that prevents a direct comparison for that isolated treatment group [^src1]. 

Because this analysis is drawn from a single dated section, no longitudinal trends, improvements, or declines over time can be established from this data alone.

## Table: AFDK_2024.pdf, p. 77

Rows compare: antikoagulationsbehandlingstype · Columns show: antal-og-andel

| Antikoagulationsbehandling | Antal | Andel (%) | Antal | Andel (%) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Alle | 134161 | 97.86 | 2929 | 2.14 |
| AK-behandling | 99866 | 97.70 | 2349 | 2.30 |
| DOAC | — | — | — | — |
| Marevan | 6321 | 97.62 | 154 | 2.38 |
| Både DOAC og Marevan | 1000 | 93.55 | 69 | 6.45 |
| Hverken DOAC eller Marevan | 26974 | 98.69 | 357 | 1.31 |

Entities: supplerende-analyser-7, doac, marevan

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner forekomsten af alvorlig blødning blandt prævalente patienter med atrieflimren efter type af antikoagulationsbehandling, og viser at kombineret DOAC og Marevan-behandling har den højeste andel af alvorlig blødning (6,45 %).
